errors.text_span: Für Aluminium beträgt der Anteil 2021 11,3 %, 2022 11,4 % und 2023 8,3 %
errors.evidence: The values for Aluminium in the figure are 3.6% (2021), 2.7% (2022), and 1.0% (2023) for Germany, and 3.2% (2021), 2.8% (2022), and 1.7% (2023) for the EU. The machine-generated description incorrectly states 11.3%, 11.4%, and 8.3%.

The values for Kupfer in the figure are 8.3% (2021), 11.3% (2022), and 2.2% (2023) for Germany, and 4.4% (2021), 5.1% (2022), and 1.3% (2023) for the EU. The machine-generated description incorrectly states 2.7%, 3.2%, and 1.3%.

The values for Nickel in the figure are 25.1% (2021), 24.7% (2022), and 11.4% (2023) for Germany, and 24.3% (2021), 23.3% (2022), and 14.6% (2023) for the EU. The machine-generated description incorrectly states 2.2%, 4.4%, and 5.1%.
